## ctxloom fragment list

List all fragments

### Synopsis

List all fragments from all installed bundles.

Use --bundle to filter by a specific bundle.

```
ctxloom fragment list [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -b, --bundle string   Filter by bundle name
```
